set.body: Remaining goal: compare eyes4s canonical output with licensed EDF Access API and vendor EDF2ASC evidence under explicit field semantics. The portable independent-reader differential and metamorphic court is complete in child bd-01M03XFR686FQYV842ZWCXX876 and remains prerequisite evidence, not vendor certification. Acceptance criteria: permitted real EDF fixtures are compared to EDF API and vendor ASC manifests; timestamps, ordering, eye identity, record kinds, messages, blocks, and counts compare exactly; token-level ASC values remain exact while EDF-to-ASC comparisons use named converter-derived tolerances; unsupported converter configurations fail as unsupported; every mismatch names fixture, operands, field path, expected, actual, and tolerance; the court emits a machine-readable vendor result summary for release certification.
